# Exact degree-4 boundary of [ (2,2), (6^6) ].  Partitions are stored
# without trailing zeroes.  A complete positive-degree Pieri row h_t*s_lambda
# in degree d has |lambda|=d-t and lambda in the interval.
i=j=p=c=4//2  # i=j=2; p,c below are recorded separately
p=c=4
lower=(2,2)
upper=(6,6,6,6,6,6)
d=4
C=[(2,2)]
B=C[:]
D=[]
rows=[] # no t>=1 has a source partition in the interval of degree d-t<4
P=[]
M=[]
U=[]
A=[]
# exact empty-matrix conventions
assert C==[(2,2)] and B==[(2,2)] and D==[]
assert rows==[] and M==[] and P==[] and U==[] and A==[]
assert len(D)==0 and len(P)==0
# det(I_0)=1; the zero 0x1 matrix presents Z^B.
det_U=1
smith=[]
quotient_free_rank=len(B)
torsion=[]
residual_checks=[]
assert det_U==1 and smith==[] and quotient_free_rank==1 and torsion==[]
print('INPUT i,j,p,c =', (2,2,p,c))
print('INPUT lower =', lower, 'upper =', upper, 'degree =', d)
print('C_4 =', C)
print('B_4 =', B, 'D_4 =', D)
print('COMPLETE_PIERI_ROWS_4 =', rows)
print('P_4 =', P, 'M_4 =', M)
print('U_4 = I_0 =', U, 'DET_U_4 =', det_U)
print('RESIDUAL_CHECKS =', residual_checks)
print('SMITH_DIAGONAL_4 =', smith)
print('QUOTIENT_FREE_RANK_4 =', quotient_free_rank, 'TORSION_4 =', torsion)
print('EXIT_ASSERTIONS = PASS')
